sections.title: GCC build-operate-transfer
sections.subtitle: We build and run your GCC, then hand it over.

sections.heading: Build capability today. Take ownership when ready.
sections.body:
GCC build-operate-transfer combines the set-up and operation of a Global Capability Centre with a planned handover to your organisation. We build and run your GCC, then hand it over.

Linkfields brings specialist talent, tooling and embedded IP to the engagement. Our delivery footprint includes the Hyderabad offshore delivery centre in India and 5+ data & development centres, supported by 550+ people and 150+ consultants.

sections.heading: An engagement designed for eventual ownership

cards.title: Build the centre
cards.description: Establish the operating model, delivery foundations and initial team around an agreed scope.

cards.title: Run the centre
cards.description: Run delivery against agreed priorities, responsibilities and performance measures.

cards.title: Transfer ownership
cards.description: Prepare the documentation, knowledge and responsibilities for an agreed handover.

cards.title: Specialist talent

cards.title: Delivery tooling

cards.title: GCC governance

sections.title: Build a GCC with a clear path to ownership

sections.heading: A phased journey from set-up to handover

items.title: Agree the blueprint
items.description: Define the centre’s purpose, scope, governance and transfer principles before delivery begins.

items.title: Build & launch
items.description: Establish the team, tooling and delivery practices, then transition agreed work into the centre.

items.title: Operate & stabilise
items.description: Manage delivery, develop team capability and use regular reviews to address risks and improve performance.

items.title: Scale & govern
items.description: Add capability in line with demand while maintaining clear accountability, tooling and embedded delivery IP.

items.title: Transfer & transition
items.description: Assess readiness against agreed criteria. Transfer knowledge, documentation and operating responsibilities through a planned handover.

cards.title: Clear ownership
cards.description: Agree the future operating responsibilities and handover expectations early in the engagement.

cards.title: Knowledge continuity
cards.description: Keep documentation, working practices and team knowledge current throughout operation.

cards.title: Readiness reviews
cards.description: Use agreed operational and delivery criteria to guide the timing and sequence of transfer.
